item.tib: bstan srung dam can bka' bsgo ngar grag 'brug gi sgra
item.coloph: tshul 'di nas (ni) bstan srung mnyes zhing bstan pa gnyan pa'i phyir dang / blo dman mngon rtogs la 'jug bde'i slad du/ gshen gyi drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba'o//

item.tib: bstan srung dam can bka' bsgo ngar grags 'brug gis sgra
item.coloph: de ltar rnams (rnam) pa kun gsal mchod bskong (skong) 'di/ bstan srung yon tan dran pa'i blos byas/ shes drin gzo'i tshul du bdag gis sbyar/ blo chung khong dge'i don du 'gyur phyir yin/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na dam can gnyen la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun zung 'jug sku thob shogag tshul 'di nas (ni) lha bstan srung mnyes zhing bstan pa gnyan pa'i phyir dang / blo dman mngon rtogs la 'jug bde'i slad du/ gshen gyi drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba'o//
